introHtml: Poly propylene tools offer a balance of lightweight handling and impact resistance that metal or wooden tools cannot match. For safety managers issuing giveaway multi-tools or HR directors assembling welcome kits, these plastic tools reduce injury risk while still providing functional utility. The material accepts pad printing and laser engraving cleanly, allowing your logo to stand out on bottle openers, spatulas, or mini screwdrivers without adding shipping weight.
